universeOpen.route: POST /internal/project-repositories/open (unchanged path and response shape; 1.1.0 adds one request key for the builder branch)

request.computerLabelRule: 1.1.0: required by the builder branch, ignored by the hired branch (absent there, as before). ^[0-9a-f]{16}$: the first 16 hex of sha256('ezil-os/computer-label/v1|' + computerId) of the person's own computer the open targets (universe-repo-open-v1 COMPUTER_LABEL), computed by the OS app server, never taken from the browser. Missing or malformed on a builder project: 403 project_repo_not_authorized (the uniform refusal; no new code), before Works is called. The label is not authorization: it only partitions the Works session (and so what os-sessions/revoke can target). Account authority is the bearer's sub (Works ownedByRepositoryId); computer authority is the OS Worker's v2 claims plus the .bind 'v1 <subject> <repositoryId> <url>' check at install.

universeOpen.identity: Unchanged: EzilIdTokenVerifier (iss exactly https://id.ezil.work/, aud in services.ezil_os.id_token_audiences, Universe's own client excluded, exp/iat/nbf, sub), then exactly one active users row with provider 'auth0' and provider_id = sub.
universeOpen.resolution: Hired first, unchanged: projects.public_id = projectId and a project_repositories row for it with id = repositoryId. Only when no hired project has that public_id: builder_projects.public_id = projectId AND builder_projects.repository_id = repositoryId. A projectId that is a hired AND a builder public_id is refused (403), never guessed. Invariant asserted by tests: a hired repository id never equals its project's id.
universeOpen.builderAuthorization: role builder, only for the account that is builder_projects.user_id; the project is not deleted; repository_state is 'ready'; clone_url is exactly 'https://' + paired Works Git host + '/' + route_name + '.git'. Every other case is 403 project_repo_not_authorized, the same answer as a project that does not exist (no existence oracle). The per-account rate limit (60/min) and the append-only open audit apply as for hired projects.
universeOpen.grant: 1.1.0: Universe calls Works POST /v1/builder/selfserve-repositories/{builder_projects.repository_id}/os-grant on its paired Works (api-staging, the universe-repo-open-v1 QA row) with bearer = the request's own userIdToken (the person's OS-audience EZiL ID token, already verified; never logged, stored or sent anywhere else) and body exactly {computerLabel, class: 'project'}. It checks the 201 answer exactly (universe-repo-open-v1 works.osGrantProjectResponse): exactly its 11 keys; class 'project'; username 'ezil'; token matching ^egg_[0-9a-f]{64}$; repositoryId = the request's; cloneUrl exactly builder_projects.clone_url; expiresAt an ISO datetime after now and at most min(now + 300 s, userIdToken.exp) + 30 s; scope 'read' or 'write'; defaultBranch a branch name (BRANCH_RE). Any other status or answer, including the 60-minute web-clone grant and a legacy answer without class, is 502 project_repo_upstream_unavailable. Universe never substitutes a ref: binding.ref is 'refs/heads/' + defaultBranch, never a guessed 'refs/heads/main', which would open an existing repository as an empty clone without an error. Renewal (calling open again, then repo-grant) is scheduled from the returned expiresAt, never from a fixed timer (universe-repo-open-v1 works.projectGrantRenewal; pushGrant.refreshEndpoint.cadence).

perTabRestore.ownFiles: The tab's record {v:1, path} lives in sessionStorage (per tab, never a URL) and travels only in the Code mint's POST body. The server strips ITS root, refuses .ezil/** and projects/<uuid>/** as not_allowed, and the computer walks the rest with no symlink followed: Cloudflare in the container (code-folder-resolve.ts cloudflareCodeFolderResolver), AWS on the host (awsCodeFolderResolver → the edge's folder op). The answer is a code; only 'restored' puts the folder in the server-built code-server URL.
perTabRestore.projectTab: The record is the app link's {project, repo} UUIDs only (not secrets; the same as the shell URL). Every restore re-runs the whole project open: computer ownership, Universe authorization with the current EZiL ID, a fresh grant of at most 5 minutes. No grant, token, remote or path is stored or put in a URL. 'path' stays reveal-only and is never an editor root.
perTabRestore.wrongUser: Walks and opens run only on the signed-in person's own computer (the v2 claims bind sandbox and user); a record another person left in the same tab reveals nothing (codes only) and can only open the signed-in person's own folder. Proposal for the shell: key records by (EZiL ID subject digest, computerId) and drop any mismatch.
